title: Nutrient Broth

references.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

purpose: The liquid counterpart to Nutrient Agar; used for broth cultures, growth curves, and as a base for many derived media.

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

preparationSummary: Dissolve the dehydrated powder in distilled/deionized water per the manufacturer's stated concentration, dispense into tubes/flasks, then sterilize.

sterilization.value: commonly autoclaved at 121°C for 15 minutes for typical tube/flask volumes
sterilization.dependsOn: batch volume and container — not universal for every load

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

storage: Store prepared broth tightly capped at room temperature or refrigerated per manufacturer guidance, protected from contamination.
expectedAppearance: Clear, pale amber liquid; turbidity after inoculation indicates growth.
qualityControl: Include an uninoculated control tube to confirm sterility of the batch.
manufacturerNotes: Composition mirrors Nutrient Agar minus the agar; confirm against the specific product insert.
